description: A QOL mod for Kuudra (Hypixel Skyblock).

releases.notes:
Additions:
- Added 26.3 Support
- Added Stun Reminder
- Added Tentacle Grab Warning
- Added Kuudra Rotation based direction display (this saves like 1-2 ticks sometimes)
- Added toggle for donator names and a refresh button
- Added formatting codes support for Visual Words
- Added Preserve Last Open Page for profile viewer
- Added Sacks to Profile Viewer
- Added Greenhouse information to Profile Viewer
- Added Coop Member Information when hovering over playernames in the profile viewer
- Added Secrets Per Run to Profile Viewer
- Added warnings when ping is set to 0 in about tab
- Added Museum Upgrades Tab to Profile viewer

Other Changes:
- Reworked the Main GUI slightly
- Hides empty tabs on the standard version
- Changed Dungeon PB times to round down instead of up and show decimals on hover
- Removed a few unnecessary descriptions
- Shitter List is now toggleable
- Changed museum tab colours

Additions:
- New Changelog Window appears when starting new version or when a new version is available (can be toggled off in about tab)
- Share Pearl Cancel Toggle (see below)
- Scrollable tooltips are always enabled in profile viewer
- Misc tab now shows faction and dojo data
- Overflow Catacombs and Class XP now calculated
- Fatal Tempo Terminator now shows on the berserker page
- Added a toggle to use pearl refill in dungeons

BugFixes:
- Fixed profile viewer showing incorrect foraging level cap
- Fixed an issue where the equals -> square double pearl would point at shop not square.

Pearl Cancel data gathering information:
Toggle in the about tab sends information about tentacle grab attempts, and pearl cancel attempts. This information is anonymous and will be used to create a pearl cancel helper to tell you where to pearl cancel based on given tentacle layouts.

This feature is disabled by default but it would be greatly appreciated if you would enable it as it does not impact gameplay in any way.
fixed a minor compatibility issue with the main tab in the profile viewer

Version 1.7.0
Profile Viewer:
- Full featured profile viewer
- Networth Calculator
- Overflow skill calculations
- Shows missing and upgradeable accessories
- Automatically detects per-class dungeon gear
- Automatically detects highest tier kuudra gear

Authentication:
The mod no longer uses api keys from the discord bot, instead authenticating with Mojang's session service. (Notice: The PhantomAddons server never receives your session token, just a username and confirmation from Mojang. Your access token and password never leave your computer, and the server only receives your username to verify the sign-in. This is only gathered for the purpose of rate limiting, profile viewer features won't work without this sign in.)

Other Features:
- Custom nametags for supporters
- Pearl Refill now has a work in dungeons toggle
- Kuudra Profit Tracker now doesnt show in unrelated guis
- Reworked code for main gui to be more easily readable

- Added Rend Attribution
- Added Boss Jump Blocker (prevents jumping for the first 5 seconds of boss phase to help with no jump boost muscle memory)
- Added Essence of Crimson and Echo of Essence sliders
- Fixed some issues with the rend tracker timing
- Fixed Slot Bind lines not showing
- Altered the settings for slot bindings
- Moved config files to a separate folder in the Minecraft config
- Added Elle outline and beacon colour pickers
- Added chest tracker HUD to the HUD editor
- Added /phantom help command
- Fixed a bug where auto kick would falsely kick for no rend build when api is disabled
- Added runs per hour and profit per hour to the profit tracker
- Reordered the about tab
- Removed most dev features from the main build
